Messages.Author: Simon Klibisch
Messages.Body:
Hi!
I would like to know if Extortion (Serpentis Card) is playable by a vampire
in torpor.
Thanks in advance,
Simon

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Hi!
>I would like to know if Extortion (Serpentis Card) is playable by a vampire
>in torpor.

Since there is no explicit card text allowing it to be played by a vampire in
torpor, it can't be. So no.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Correct. Only ready vampires can play reaction cards. [1.6.3.5]
